description: Dense midpoint interaction-picture integration for a Hamiltonian split H = H0 + V. For canonical Pauli inputs, diagonal I/Z terms form H0 by default; callers may choose reference term indices explicitly.
applicable_hamiltonians: Small Hamiltonians with a useful solvable or diagonal reference component
Canonical PauliHamiltonian inputs containing diagonal I/Z terms
Legacy lists of Hermitian dense matrix terms with an explicitly chosen reference term
limitations: Only dense unitary output is implemented
The default split is a heuristic and may not be the physically or numerically best interaction-picture reference
No time-dependent oracle, LCU, circuit, or asymptotic interaction-picture resource model is provided

steps.description: Number of midpoint interaction-picture integration steps.

reference_term_indices.description: Optional non-empty, unique indices of Hamiltonian terms forming H0. Defaults to all diagonal I/Z Pauli terms, or the first dense term.

execution.returns: EvolutionResult containing a dense unitary and the selected reference/perturbation split.

complexity.gate_count: Not applicable: this dense reference does not synthesize a circuit
complexity.error_scaling: The midpoint interaction-picture discretization has second-order global convergence in the time-step size for a fixed, sufficiently regular split.
